items.meaning: 动态主机配置协议，提供一种使用 TCP/IP 协议族向主机传送配置参数的机制。
其报文格式被 DHCP 报文格式所基于的协议，从而使 DHCP 与 BOOTP 参与方在特定情形下可以交换报文。
一种选项：DHCP 服务器收到的任何包含该选项的报文都被假定为由 DHCP 客户端发送。
BOOTP 客户端发来的请求报文，未配置支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器收到后会静默丢弃它。
items.constraint: that server silently discards the BOOTREQUEST message
items.condition: If a DHCP server that is not configured to support BOOTP clients receives a BOOTREQUEST message from a BOOTP client

items.meaning: 已配置支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器，可以被配置为提供静态地址、自动地址或两者。
items.constraint: it may be configured to supply static addresses, automatic addresses or both
items.object: static addresses, automatic addresses or both
items.condition: If a DHCP server is configured to support BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 由系统管理员事先分配、并存放在 DHCP 服务器可访问的数据库中的地址。
由 DHCP 服务器从其未分配地址池中选出的地址。
允许 DHCP 服务器返回自动地址的决定必须由系统管理员掌控。
items.constraint: the decision to allow a DHCP server to return automatic addresses must be under the control of the system administrator
items.object: the decision to allow a DHCP server to return automatic addresses

items.meaning: 向 BOOTP 客户端提供自动地址的特性必须是可配置的。
items.constraint: this feature must be configurable
items.condition: If a DHCP server supports supplying automatic addresses to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 该特性必须默认为关闭。
items.constraint: the feature must default off
items.condition: If a DHCP server supports supplying automatic addresses to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 启用该特性必须是系统管理员主动决定的结果。
items.constraint: Enabling of the feature must be the result of an active decision by the system administrator
items.action: be the result of an active decision by the system administrator

items.meaning: 向 BOOTP 客户端分配自动地址时，DHCP 服务器必须赋予无限租期。
items.constraint: the DHCP server must assign an infinite lease duration to for automatic addresses assigned to BOOTP clients
items.object: an infinite lease duration to for automatic addresses assigned to BOOTP clients
items.condition: If a DHCP server returns a automatic address

items.meaning: 分配给 BOOTP 客户端的此类网络地址不能被服务器自动重新分配。
items.constraint: Such network addresses cannot be automatically reassigned by the server
items.action: be automatically reassigned by the server

items.meaning: 本地系统管理员可以选择手动释放分配给 BOOTP 客户端的网络地址。
items.constraint: The local system administrator may choose to manually release network addresses assigned to BOOTP clients
items.object: network addresses assigned to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器必须按 BOOTP 协议与 BOOTP 客户端交互。
items.constraint: 支持 BOOTP 客户端的 DHCP 服务器必须按 BOOTP 协议与 BOOTP 客户端交互

items.meaning: 服务器必须构造 BOOTP BOOTREPLY 报文而不是 DHCP DHCPOFFER 报文。
items.constraint: 服务器必须构造 BOOTP BOOTREPLY 报文而非 DHCP DHCPOFFER 报文
items.object: a BOOTP BOOTREPLY message rather than a DHCP DHCPOFFER message

items.meaning: 服务器不得在 BOOTP 回复中包含 'DHCP message type' 选项。
items.constraint: 不得包含 'DHCP message type' 选项

items.meaning: BOOTP 回复不得超出 BOOTREPLY 报文的长度限制。
items.constraint: 不得超过 BOOTREPLY 报文的长度限制
items.object: the size limit for BOOTREPLY messages

items.meaning: 服务器在发送 BOOTP BOOTREPLY 后，将 BOOTP 客户端的绑定标记为 BOUND。
DHCP 服务器可以向 BOOTP 客户端发送 'DHCP Options and BOOTP Vendor Extensions' RFC 所允许的任意 DHCP 选项。
items.constraint: 可发送 RFC [2] 允许的任意 DHCP 选项
items.object: any DHCP Options to a BOOTP client
items.condition: as allowed by the "DHCP Options and BOOTP Vendor Extensions" RFC [2]

items.meaning: 可以（在满足随附条件的情况下）向 BOOTP 客户端返还自动分配的地址。
items.constraint: 可向 BOOTP 客户端返还自动分配的地址

items.meaning: 若向 BOOTP 客户端返还自动分配的地址，则必须提供配置开关。
items.constraint: 必须提供配置开关
items.condition: if returning automatic addresses to BOOTP clients

items.meaning: 该可选配置必须默认置为 OFF。
items.constraint: 必须默认将该可选配置置为 OFF

items.meaning: DHCP 与 BOOTP 客户端交互时必须遵守的规范。
items.constraint: MUST abide by the BOOTP specification when interacting with BOOTP clients
items.condition: when interacting with BOOTP clients

items.meaning: DHCP 选项文档中定义的选项，可发送给 BOOTP 客户端。
items.constraint: MAY send DHCP options [...] to a BOOTP client

items.meaning: DHCP 客户端可以在 BOOTP 服务器返回的配置可接受时使用该回复。
items.constraint: MAY use a reply from a BOOTP server if the configuration returned from the BOOTP server is acceptable to the DHCP client
items.object: a reply from a BOOTP server
items.condition: if the configuration returned from the BOOTP server is acceptable to the DHCP client

items.meaning: DHCP 客户端必须假定 BOOTP 服务器消息中返回的 IP 地址具有无限租期。
items.constraint: MUST assume that an IP address returned in a message from a BOOTP server has an infinite lease
items.object: an IP address returned in a message from a BOOTP server has an infinite lease

items.meaning: DHCP 客户端应优先选用 DHCP 服务器的回复而非 BOOTP 服务器的回复。
items.constraint: SHOULD choose to use a reply from a DHCP server in preference to a reply from a BOOTP server
items.object: a reply from a DHCP server in preference to a reply from a BOOTP server

items.meaning: 原 BOOTP 规范未明确规定该类中继代理的精确行为。
BOOTP 的一种扩展，本文档的信息与要求同样适用（除另有规定外）。
REQUIRED denotes an item that is an absolute requirement of the specification.
items.constraint: absolute requirement of the specification

items.meaning: RECOMMENDED denotes an item for which valid reasons to ignore it may exist in particular circumstances, but the implications should be understood and the case carefully weighed before choosing a different course.
items.constraint: may exist valid reasons in particular circumstances to ignore this item, but the full implications should be understood and the case carefully weighed before choosing a different course

items.meaning: OPTIONAL denotes an item that is truly optional, so one vendor may include it and another vendor may omit it.
items.constraint: this item is truly optional

items.meaning: A BOOTP entity is specified to silently discard a received BOOTP message in several cases.
items.constraint: silently discard a received BOOTP message

items.meaning: To silently discard a received BOOTP message means to discard the message without further processing and without sending any ICMP error message as a result.
items.constraint: discard the message without further processing, and do not send any ICMP error message as a result

items.meaning: For diagnosis of problems, the entity SHOULD provide the capability of logging the error, including the contents of the silently-discarded message, and SHOULD record the event in a statistics counter.
items.constraint: SHOULD provide the capability of logging the error, including the contents of the silently-discarded message, and SHOULD record the event in a statistics counter
items.action: provide the capability of logging the error, including the contents of the silently-discarded message, and record the event in a statistics counter
items.object: logging capability and statistics counter event
items.condition: for diagnosis of problems

items.meaning: 对于表示数值量的多八位组字段，整个字段最左边的比特是最高有效位。
应当对 BOOTP 消息执行下列一致性检查。
items.constraint: SHOULD perform consistency checks on BOOTP messages
items.object: following consistency checks on BOOTP messages

items.entity: IP Total Length and UDP Length
items.meaning: IP Total Length 与 UDP Length 必须足够大，足以容纳 [1] 中规定的 300 个八位组的最小 BOOTP 首部。
items.constraint: must be large enough to contain the minimal BOOTP header of 300 octets
items.object: the minimal BOOTP header of 300 octets (in the UDP data field) specified in [1]

items.meaning: 根据 IP Total Length 和 UDP Length 字段判断，大于 [1] 所规定最小尺寸的 BOOTP 消息也必须被接受。
items.constraint: BOOTP messages larger than the minimum size specified by [1] MUST also be accepted
items.object: BOOTP messages which, according to the IP Total Length and UDP Length fields, are larger than the minimum size specified by [1]
items.condition: which, according to the IP Total Length and UDP Length fields, are larger than the minimum size specified by [1]

items.meaning: 消息的 op（opcode）字段必须包含 BOOTREQUEST(1) 的代码或 BOOTREPLY(2) 的代码之一。
items.constraint: must contain either the code for a BOOTREQUEST (1) or the code for a BOOTREPLY (2)
items.object: either the code for a BOOTREQUEST (1) or the code for a BOOTREPLY (2)

items.meaning: 不满足这些一致性检查的BOOTP消息必须被静默丢弃
items.constraint: MUST be silently discarded
items.object: BOOTP messages not meeting these consistency checks
items.condition: BOOTP messages not meeting these consistency checks

items.meaning: 'flags'字段其余保留位由客户端置零
items.constraint: MUST be set to zero by clients
items.object: the remaining bits of the 'flags' field

items.meaning: 服务器必须忽略'flags'字段的保留位
items.constraint: ignored by servers
items.object: the remaining bits of the 'flags' field

items.meaning: MBZ（必须为零）字段为将来使用保留，必须置零
items.constraint: MUST BE ZERO

items.meaning: 'chaddr'字段中路级硬件地址所用的比特顺序应与ARP协议所用顺序相同
items.constraint: SHOULD be the same as the ordering used for the ARP protocol
items.object: the ordering used for the ARP protocol on the client's link-level network
items.condition: assuming ARP is defined for that network

items.meaning: 'chaddr'字段必须按BOOTP客户端指定的原样保留
items.constraint: MUST be preserved as it was specified by the BOOTP client

items.meaning: 中继代理不得颠倒'chaddr'字段的比特顺序
items.constraint: MUST NOT reverse the bit ordering of the 'chaddr' field
items.object: the bit ordering of the 'chaddr' field
items.condition: even if it happens to be relaying a BOOTREQUEST between two networks which use different bit orderings

items.meaning: BOOTP 报文中的 chaddr 字段，其内容常被用来创建 ARP 缓存表项，需一致解释才能实现互操作。
由于非透明桥接，客户/服务器与客户/中继代理的交互在 IEEE 802.5 网络上需给予特别考虑。
客户端应使用带 All Routes Explorer RIF 的广播 BOOTREQUEST 发送请求。
items.constraint: 客户端应使用带 All Routes Explorer RIF 的广播 BOOTREQUEST
items.object: its broadcast BOOTREQUEST with an All Routes Explorer RIF

items.meaning: 无法缓存返回路由的服务器/中继代理应将 BOOTREPLY 以 Spanning Tree Rooted RIF 发往从 BOOTP 报文取得的客户端硬件地址。
items.constraint: 无法缓存返回路由时，BOOTREPLY 应发往客户端硬件地址并使用 Spanning Tree Rooted RIF
items.object: the BOOTREPLY message to the client's hardware address, as taken from the BOOTP message, with a Spanning Tree Rooted RIF
items.condition: For those server/relay agents which cannot cache the return route (because they are stateless, for example)

items.meaning: Routing Information Field，在假定网络被桥接时会被使用，从而在环上带来少量多余字节。
属于该类别的客户端应把其生成的 BOOTREPLY 报文中 'flags' 字段的 BROADCAST 标志置 1，以提示服务器与中继代理应尝试向该客户端广播 BOOTREPLY。
items.constraint: 此类客户端应将 BROADCAST 标志置 1
items.object: the newly-defined BROADCAST flag in the 'flags' field of BOOTREPLY messages it generates
items.condition: If a client falls into this category

items.meaning: 客户端在能够接收单播 BOOTREPLY 时应清除该标志
items.condition: If a client does not have this limitation (i.e., it is perfectly able to receive unicast BOOTREPLY messages)

items.meaning: 旧主机实现应被修改以便能接收单播 BOOTREPLY 消息
flags 字段其余比特保留供未来使用
items.constraint: remaining bits of the 'flags' field are reserved for future use

items.meaning: 客户端在生成的 BOOTREQUEST 中必须将保留比特置零
items.object: these bits to zero in all BOOTREQUEST messages it generates

items.meaning: 客户端必须忽略 BOOTREPLY 中的保留比特
items.object: these bits in all BOOTREPLY messages

items.meaning: secs 字段应表示客户端发出首个 BOOTREQUEST 以来经过的秒数
items.object: the elapsed time, in seconds, since the client sent its first BOOTREQUEST message

items.meaning: 首个 BOOTREQUEST 的 secs 字段应置零
items.object: the 'secs' field of the first BOOTREQUEST message to zero

items.meaning: 客户端不应把 secs 字段设为对所有 BOOTREQUEST 都恒定的值
items.object: the 'secs' field to a value which is constant for all BOOTREQUEST messages

items.meaning: 'secs' 字段的原始定义含糊，不清楚它表示的是自第一条 BOOTREQUEST 发送以来的时间还是诸如客户端开机以来的其他时间段。
由于字节序错误，让客户端显得等待更久，relay agent 会比期望更早（通常是立即）转发 BOOTREQUEST。
这些实现错误进一步削弱了 'secs' 字段的可用性。
这些不正确的实现应当被纠正。
items.constraint: 不正确的实现应被纠正

items.meaning: 若 BOOTP 客户端不知道应使用哪个 IP 地址，应把 'ciaddr' 字段设置为 0.0.0.0。
items.constraint: 客户端不知道应使用的 IP 地址时，应把 'ciaddr' 设为 0.0.0.0
items.condition: If a BOOTP client does not know what IP address it should be using

items.meaning: 若客户端能记住上次分配的 IP 地址，或已通过其他机制预配置了 IP 地址，客户端可以用该 IP 地址填充 'ciaddr' 字段。
items.constraint: 满足条件时可用该地址填充 'ciaddr'
items.object: the 'ciaddr' field with that IP address
items.condition: If the client has the ability to remember the last IP address it was assigned, or it has been preconfigured with an IP address via some alternate mechanism

items.meaning: 若客户端确实在 'ciaddr' 中放了非零 IP 地址，必须准备好接收发往该地址的入站单播数据报，并应答该地址的 ARP 请求。
items.constraint: 在 'ciaddr' 中放入非零地址时必须能接收该地址的单播数据报并应答其 ARP 请求
items.object: incoming unicast datagrams addressed to that IP address and also answer ARP requests for that IP address
items.condition: If the client does place a non-zero IP address in the 'ciaddr' field
items.exception: (if ARP is used on that network)

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器可以自由分配与客户端在 'ciaddr' 中给出的不同的 IP 地址（在 'yiaddr' 字段中）。
客户端应采纳 'yiaddr' 中指定的 IP 地址并尽快开始使用它。
items.constraint: 客户端应采纳 'yiaddr' 中的地址并尽快使用
items.object: the IP address specified in 'yiaddr' and begin using it

items.meaning: 关于 'ciaddr' 字段的用途存在多种解释，且未就单一正确解释达成一致。
在某一种解释中，BOOTP 仅被用于获取启动文件和/或来自 'vend' 字段的信息。
最后一种解释是不正确的，因为它可能阻止 BOOTREPLY 到达客户端。
服务器通常会把回复单播到 'ciaddr' 中给出的地址。
BOOTP 客户端在其生成的所有 BOOTREQUEST 报文中必须将 'giaddr' 字段置零（0.0.0.0）。
items.constraint: BOOTP client MUST set 'giaddr' to zero (0.0.0.0) in all BOOTREQUEST messages it generates
items.condition: in all BOOTREQUEST messages it generates

items.meaning: BOOTP 客户端不得将 BOOTREPLY 报文的 'giaddr' 字段解释为 IP 路由器的 IP 地址。
items.constraint: BOOTP client MUST NOT interpret the 'giaddr' field of a BOOTREPLY message to be the IP address of an IP router
items.object: the 'giaddr' field of a BOOTREPLY message to be the IP address of an IP router

items.meaning: BOOTP 客户端应完全忽略 BOOTREPLY 报文中 'giaddr' 字段的内容。
items.constraint: A BOOTP client SHOULD completely ignore the contents of the 'giaddr' field in BOOTREPLY messages
items.object: the contents of the 'giaddr' field in BOOTREPLY messages

items.meaning: 引述的说明：若 'giaddr'（网关地址）非零，则报文应先转发到该地址以便到达服务器（该句为对既有规定的引述，非本文档自身的规范性要求）。
“get to”指的是 BOOTP 交换之后客户端到服务器的通信（如 TFTP 会话）；'giaddr' 可能包含本身并非 IP 路由器的 BOOTP 中继代理地址，此时它作为 TFTP 报文的第一跳无用（按定义非路由器不在 IP 层转发数据报）。
尽管现已被本备忘录第 4.1.1 节禁止，按 [1] 第 8 节第六段 'giaddr' 字段仍可能包含广播地址；这样的地址既不能用作路由器地址，还可能使客户端对广播地址发起 ARP（若 BOOTREPLY 未提供子网掩码则无法识别子网广播地址），这显然不可取。
Vendor Information Extensions 中的 Gateway 子字段（若存在）可用于让客户端获取第一跳路由器地址以到达非本地服务器。
BOOTP 客户端应将 BOOTREQUEST 的 vend 字段前四个八位组填为称为 magic cookie 的四八位组标识符。
items.constraint: fill the first four octets of the 'vend' (vendor information) field of a BOOTREQUEST with a four-octet identifier called a "magic cookie"
items.object: the first four octets of the 'vend' (vendor information) field of a BOOTREQUEST with a four-octet identifier called a "magic cookie"
items.exception: even if it has no special information to communicate to the BOOTP server using the 'vend' field

items.meaning: 当未使用特殊的厂商专用 magic cookie 时，BOOTP 客户端应使用点分十进制值 99.130.83.99 作为 magic cookie。
items.constraint: use the dotted decimal value 99.130.83.99 as specified in [2]
items.condition: If a special vendor-specific magic cookie is not being used

items.meaning: 在客户端无信息要告知服务器时，紧跟在 magic cookie 之后的八位组应被设为 End 标记（255）。
items.constraint: the octet immediately following the magic cookie SHOULD be set to the "End" tag (255)
items.object: the octet immediately following the magic cookie to the "End" tag (255)
items.condition: if the client has no information to communicate to the server

items.meaning: 在客户端无信息要告知服务器时，vend 字段的其余八位组应被设为零。
items.constraint: the remaining octets of the 'vend' field SHOULD be set to zero
items.object: the remaining octets of the 'vend' field
items.condition: if the client has no information to communicate to the server

items.meaning: 若客户端在其 BOOTREQUEST 中包含 magic cookie，服务器至少能知道客户端期望并能在相应 BOOTREPLY 中理解的格式。
为避免与 IP 路由器的 IP 转发功能混淆，原先称为 "BOOTP forwarding agent" 的第三方代理改称为 "BOOTP relay agent"。
BOOTP 中继代理执行的任务不同于 IP 路由器的普通 IP 转发功能。
items.constraint: 中继代理实现不应将 BOOTP 消息当作普通数据包直接转发。

items.meaning: 中继代理功能最方便地部署在连接客户端和路由器的路由器中，也可放在直连客户端子网的主机上。

items.entity: Any Internet host or router which provides BOOTP relay-agent capability
items.meaning: 提供 BOOTP 中继代理能力的任何 Internet 主机或路由器必须符合本备忘录规范。
items.constraint: 必须符合本备忘录中的规范。
items.condition: Any Internet host or router which provides BOOTP relay-agent capability

items.entity: unicast datagram with an IP destination not matching any of the router's IP addresses
items.meaning: 目的 IP 不匹配路由器任何 IP 地址的单播数据报不被视为由路由器逻辑 BOOTP 中继代理处理。

items.entity: hosts or routers which support a BOOTP relay agent
items.meaning: 支持 BOOTP 中继代理的主机或路由器必须接受源 IP 为 0.0.0.0 的 BOOTREQUEST 消息以本地递送给中继代理。
items.constraint: 必须接受源 IP 地址为 0.0.0.0 的 BOOTREQUEST 消息。
items.action: accept for local delivery to the relay agent
items.object: BOOTREQUEST messages whose IP source address is 0.0.0.0
items.condition: hosts or routers which support a BOOTP relay agent

items.entity: BOOTREQUEST messages from legal IP source addresses
items.meaning: 来自合法 IP 源地址的 BOOTREQUEST 消息也必须被接受。
items.constraint: 必须接受来自合法 IP 源地址的 BOOTREQUEST 消息。
items.object: BOOTREQUEST messages from legal IP source addresses

items.meaning: A relay agent must silently discard received UDP messages whose UDP destination port number is BOOTPC (68).
items.constraint: MUST silently discard any received UDP messages whose UDP destination port number is BOOTPC (68)
items.object: any received UDP messages whose UDP destination port number is BOOTPC (68)

items.meaning: There should be no need for a relay agent to process messages addressed to the BOOTPC port.
Some relay agent implementations incorrectly relay messages addressed to the BOOTPC port.
The consistency checks specified in Section 2.1 should be performed by the relay agent.
items.constraint: SHOULD be performed by the relay agent
items.object: The consistency checks specified in Section 2.1

items.meaning: BOOTP messages not meeting the consistency checks must be silently discarded.
items.constraint: MUST be silently discarded
items.object: BOOTP messages not meeting these consistency checks
items.condition: not meeting these consistency checks

items.meaning: Some configuration mechanism must exist to enable or disable the relaying of BOOTREQUEST messages.
items.constraint: MUST exist to enable or disable the relaying of BOOTREQUEST messages
items.object: Some configuration mechanism to enable or disable the relaying of BOOTREQUEST messages

items.meaning: Relaying must be disabled by default.
items.constraint: MUST be disabled by default
items.condition: by default

items.meaning: When the BOOTP relay agent receives a BOOTREQUEST message, it may use the value of the 'secs' field as a factor in deciding whether to relay the request.
items.constraint: MAY use the value of the 'secs' (seconds since client began booting) field of the request as a factor in deciding whether to relay the request
items.object: the value of the 'secs' (seconds since client began booting) field of the request as a factor in deciding whether to relay the request
items.condition: When the BOOTP relay agent receives a BOOTREQUEST message

items.meaning: If such a policy mechanism is implemented, its threshold should be configurable.
items.constraint: SHOULD be configurable
items.condition: If such a policy mechanism is implemented

items.meaning: A feature of the BOOTP protocol has not necessarily been shown to be useful.
The relay agent MUST silently discard BOOTREQUEST messages whose 'hops' field exceeds the value 16.
items.constraint: The relay agent MUST silently discard BOOTREQUEST messages whose 'hops' field exceeds the value 16.
items.object: BOOTREQUEST messages whose 'hops' field exceeds the value 16
items.condition: whose 'hops' field exceeds the value 16

items.meaning: A configuration option SHOULD be provided to set this threshold to a smaller value if desired by the network manager.
items.constraint: A configuration option SHOULD be provided to set this threshold to a smaller value if desired by the network manager.
items.action: be provided to set this threshold to a smaller value
